abstract: Covers the IETF HTTP State Management Mechanism for servers that set and read cookies: the Set-Cookie and Cookie header fields, the Expires, Max-Age, Domain, Path, Secure, HttpOnly and SameSite attributes, the __Secure- and __Host- name prefixes, the user agent storage model, eviction, size and lifetime limits, same-site and cross-site requests with Lax-by-default, and the security and privacy considerations (CSRF, session fixation, weak integrity across subdomains). Version lines: RFC 6265 is current, draft-ietf-httpbis-rfc6265bis-22 (in the RFC Editor queue) is a preview with posture build, and RFC 2965 and RFC 2109 are legacy, with upgrade checklists. SKILL.md holds the invariants and workflow; references split out versions, Set-Cookie attributes, SameSite and prefixes, storage and limits, and security.
